Lecture Overview:
How do frontier AI labs measure whether agents can do real work? In this Stanford CS329Z: Engineering AI Agents guest lecture, Alex Shaw and Ryan Marten of the Laude Institute, co-creators of Terminal-Bench, explain why evals have become the source of truth for agent software, how Terminal-Bench measures how well agents accomplish hard, real-world tasks in a terminal environment, and how to write tasks, design verifiers, prevent reward hacking, and maintain a benchmark with their open-source framework, Harbor.
Speakers: Alex Shaw and Ryan Marten
